title: delay timeout of notification popups when user appears to be absent
line: Notification popups no longer disappear while you're away from the computer: their timeout starts again once you're back.
explanation: Notification popups started their timeout as soon as they appeared, whether or not anyone was at the computer, so a notification that arrived while the user was away vanished before they could see it (only the history kept it). Nothing in the notifications applet looked at user activity. The change adds a small IdleWatcher (KIdleTime, 15 seconds without input, which on Wayland respects idle inhibitors such as video players) and holds the popup timer while the user is idle, the same way it is held while hovered; on the first input the popup gets its full timeout again.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: don't let popups time out while the user is away

Notification popups timed out even when nobody was at the computer, so
anything that arrived while the user was away was missed. Now the popup
timer pauses after 15 seconds without input and restarts on user return.

BUG: 456421

patches.diff:
From ebe95b4f8628839536150ef1a0b090e6337c6ad5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:37:25 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notifications: don't let popups time out while the
 user is away

Notification popups timed out even when nobody was at the computer, so
anything that arrived while the user was away was missed. Now the popup
timer pauses after 15 seconds without input and restarts on user return.

BUG: 456421

 applets/notifications/NotificationPopup.qml |  3 ++
 applets/notifications/global/Globals.qml    |  2 +

 applets/notifications/idlewatcher.h         | 33 +++++++++++++
 5 files changed, 92 insertions(+)

@@ -15,6 +16,7 @@ set(notificationapplet_SRCS

     jobaggregator.h
     thumbnailer.h
 )
@@ -83,6 +85,7 @@ target_link_libraries(org.kde.plasma.notifications PRIVATE
                       Plasma::PlasmaQuick
                       KF6::CoreAddons
                       KF6::GlobalAccel
+                      KF6::IdleTime
                       KF6::KIOGui
                       KF6::KIOWidgets # for PreviewJob
                       KF6::Notifications # for KNotificationJobUiDelegate
diff --git a/applets/notifications/NotificationPopup.qml b/applets/notifications/NotificationPopup.qml
index bfc68dfe8b..400de7c70b 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/NotificationPopup.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/NotificationPopup.qml
@@ -165,6 +165,9 @@ NotificationsApplet.NotificationWindow {
                     if (interval <= 0) {
                         return false;
                     }
+                    if (NotificationsApplet.Globals.idleWatcher.idle) {
+                        return false;
+                    }
                     if (notificationItem.dragging || notificationItem.menuOpen || activateDefaultActionDropArea.containsAcceptableDrag) {
                         return false;
                     }
diff --git a/applets/notifications/global/Globals.qml b/applets/notifications/global/Globals.qml
index 8e8e56f88d..c09d6891d0 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/global/Globals.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/global/Globals.qml
@@ -799,4 +799,6 @@ QtObject {
         onToggleDoNotDisturbTriggered: globals.toggleDoNotDisturbMode()
         onClearHistoryTriggered: plasmoidItem.clearNotificationHistoryAndShowOsd()
     }
+
+    property Notifications.IdleWatcher idleWatcher: Notifications.IdleWatcher {}
 }
diff --git a/applets/notifications/idlewatcher.cpp b/applets/notifications/idlewatcher.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..4a134dba9d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/notifications/idlewatcher.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL
+*/
+
+#include "idlewatcher.h"
+
+#include <chrono>
+
+#include <KIdleTime>
+
+using namespace std::chrono_literals;
+
+IdleWatcher::IdleWatcher(QObject *parent)
+    : QObject(parent)
+{
+    KIdleTime *idleTime = KIdleTime::instance();
+
+    connect(idleTime, &KIdleTime::timeoutReached, this, [this, idleTime](int identifier) {
+        if (identifier == m_timeoutId) {
+            setIdle(true);
+            idleTime->catchNextResumeEvent();
+        }
+    });
+    connect(idleTime, &KIdleTime::resumingFromIdle, this, [this] {
+        setIdle(false);
+    });
+
+    m_timeoutId = idleTime->addIdleTimeout(15s);
+}
+
+IdleWatcher::~IdleWatcher()
+{
+    KIdleTime::instance()->removeIdleTimeout(m_timeoutId);
+}
+
+bool IdleWatcher::idle() const
+{
+    return m_idle;
+}
+
+void IdleWatcher::setIdle(bool idle)
+{
+    if (m_idle != idle) {
+        m_idle = idle;
+        Q_EMIT idleChanged();
+    }
+}
+
+#include "moc_idlewatcher.cpp"
diff --git a/applets/notifications/idlewatcher.h b/applets/notifications/idlewatcher.h
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..1437e4ace3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/notifications/idlewatcher.h
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL
+*/
+
+#pragma once
+
+#include <QObject>
+#include <qqmlregistration.h>
+
+class IdleWatcher : public QObject
+{
+    Q_OBJECT
+    QML_ELEMENT
+
+    Q_PROPERTY(bool idle READ idle NOTIFY idleChanged)
+
+public:
+    explicit IdleWatcher(QObject *parent = nullptr);
+    ~IdleWatcher() override;
+
+    bool idle() const;
+
+Q_SIGNALS:
+    void idleChanged();
+
+private:
+    void setIdle(bool idle);
+
+    int m_timeoutId = -1;
+    bool m_idle = false;
+};
--

media.caption: Master: user idle for 20 s, notification sent, 10 s later the popup has already timed out unseen
With the fix: same steps, the popup is still waiting for the user
With the fix: 8 s after the user moves the mouse again the popup times out as usual
